meta.name: add-atomic-chat-tool
meta.description: Add Atomic Chat MCP server so the container agent can call local models served by the Atomic Chat desktop app via its OpenAI-compatible API.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让容器 agent 调用本地 AI 模型
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在容器中通过 OpenAI 兼容接口调用本地模型。
copy.tagline_en: Enable container agent to call local AI models
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to call local models from a container via OpenAI-compatible API.

howto.what: Claude能通过Atomic Chat MCP服务器调用本地运行的AI模型（如Llama），作为工具使用。它可以列出可用模型并用其中的模型生成回答。
howto.when: 当用户明确要求使用Atomic Chat的本地模型，例如说“用Atomic Chat告诉我法国的首都”时触发。

say.text: 使用Atomic Chat告诉我法国的首都
say.note: Claude会列出模型并选择一个来回答。

howto.what_en: Claude can use local AI models served by Atomic Chat (e.g., Llama) as tools via an MCP server. It can list available models and generate responses using one of them.
howto.when_en: When the user explicitly asks to use Atomic Chat's local models, e.g., by saying "use atomic chat to tell me the capital of France".

say_en.text: Use Atomic Chat to tell me the capital of France
say_en.note: Claude will list models and pick one to answer.

say_en.text: Use atomic_chat_generate tool with llama3.2-3b-instruct to answer: What is AI?
say_en.note: Claude directly calls the specified model for a response.
